properties.name: letter_grade_valid_letters
properties.description: The returned letter grade is always one of A, B, C, D, or F.

properties.name: letter_grade_a_for_high_scores
properties.description: Scores 90 and above always receive grade A.

properties.name: final_score_empty_is_none
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result is None if len(args[0]) == 0 else isinstance(result, int)
properties.description: Empty scores list returns None, non-empty list returns an int.

properties.name: final_score_within_bounds
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: len(args[0]) == 0 or (min(args[0]) <= result <= max(args[0]))
properties.description: The rounded mean is bounded by the minimum and maximum scores in the input.

properties.name: final_score_identical_elements
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: len(args[0]) == 0 or (len(set(args[0])) > 1 or result == args[0][0])
properties.description: If all input scores are identical, the final score equals that score.
